newsitem.title: USA: New York Bagel expands in Colorado.
newsitem.headline: New York Bagel expands in Colorado.

text.p: New York Bagel Enterprises Inc said Tuesday it agreed to acquire certain assets and assume certain liabilities of Lots A' Bagels Inc, of Colorado Springs, Colo.

New York Bagel said it will acquire Lots A' Bagels' operating assets, seven leased restaurants and a bagel commissary located in Colorado Springs and Monument, Colo., for about $2.7 million in cash, debt, common stock purchase warrants and the assumption of certain operating liabilities.
The purchase price may increase or decrease based on an earnout provision, New York Bagel said in a statement. The proposed acquisition is expected to be completed in December.
After the acquisition, New York Bagel said it will have at least 32 company-owned restaurants by the end of 1996, which is more than its previously stated year-end unit development schedule.
New York Bagel, which has four franchised restaurants in the Denver area, said the acquisition is expected to strengthen its position in Colorado.
Lots A' Bagels had net sales of about $3.0 million in calendar 1995, and $3.1 million for the ten-month period ended October 31, 1996.
